entities.summary: Clinton Stevenson "Praying Benny" Benedict was a Canadian professional lacrosse goalie, ice hockey goaltender who played for the Ottawa Senators and the Montreal Maroons. He played on four Stanley Cup-winning squads. He was the first goaltender in the National Hockey League (NHL) to wear a face mask. He led league goaltenders in shutouts seven times over his professional career. He is a member of the Hockey Hall of Fame. Clint Benedict was a athletes & competitors from Ottawa (1892-09-26, Ottawa–1976-11-12). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
